name: wds_country211
description: A WebDataset-derived collection of images labeled by country (211 classes) used in CLIP benchmarking setups. It measures a model’s ability to predict the originating country (geolocation) of an image, evaluating fine-grained geographic visual recognition and cultural/geographic cues in images.
reputation: Part of the CLIP/WDS benchmarking suites for geolocation-style evaluation; used in niche research on geographic/geo-cultural classification but not a broadly standardized benchmark.
